disposition_reason: Lead, chromium, nickel and cadmium were measured by AAS in 35 retail candy and chocolate brands (Table 6) and in their wrappers (Table 7) bought in Dhaka.

study.design: Retail survey of 39 candy, chocolate and litchi brands (local, imported, locally manufactured international) with wrappers; metals in 35 candy and chocolate brands
study.origin: 27 locally produced, 4 imported and 8 locally manufactured international brands (39 total, incl. litchis)
study.market: super shops, department stores, grocery and retail shops in Dhaka City, Bangladesh
study.method: Candy/chocolate oven-dried 70 °C, 1 g digested with HNO3/H2O2 on block digester; wrappers ashed 650 °C then digested; AAS (Varian AA-240, PinAAcle 900T)
study.lod_text: Not stated; non-detects printed as BDL
study.qa: Calibration standards only; recoveries of standards 101.0-102.3%; no CRM
